decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer sits close to the core offer and uses shared technology, service and consumables, so keeping it costs little while its market prospects are still resolving after only one year, which makes it a valuable option to hold.
The numbering software module is cheap to maintain and fits the firm's push toward serialization and traceability, so this low-cost option with growing strategic relevance should stay open.

The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces builds on established ink expertise and serves a broad marking need, and the evidence so far gives no sign its value won't be realized, so abandoning it early would be premature.
